guides.found: Sampling and numerical checks passed, but moderate-effect power failed in every required view. The frozen sequence stopped before the later robustness banks.
guides.unresolved: Those unrun banks are not hidden successes or failures. A correct exact calculation did not make this candidate adequately sensitive for manuscript rescoring.

guides.title: How much could the transition-preserving test miss?
guides.tested: Measured detection on the actual mixture of manuscript-layout constraints while retaining the original broad search correction.
guides.found: Every required layout/view combination missed the frozen power benchmarks. The calculation could be exact while still having a poor chance of detecting the specified moderate alternatives.
guides.unresolved: The earlier nonpassing gap result was not a decisive absence finding. No manuscript result was rescored or acceptance threshold relaxed.

guides.title: Can any local passage be certified as untouched?
guides.tested: Audited source locations against saved direct-target searches, broader atlases, and exposure receipts before considering a new power study.
guides.found: No local reserve could be certified. Some text had direct target exposure; other text had uncertain freshness rather than demonstrated protection.
guides.unresolved: Availability alone does not prove a person inspected every passage, but uncertainty cannot be relabelled untouched. No power or new order score was calculated.

guides.title: Preserving a qualification run that failed to execute
guides.tested: Attempted the registered first-stage full-family controls for the new conditional order statistic.
guides.found: The attempt stopped with a memory error while constructing the comparison family. The failed implementation, traceback, and frozen inputs were retained.
guides.unresolved: An execution failure is not a failed scientific prediction or a negative manuscript finding. A repair required a separately named and frozen attempt.

guides.title: A repaired runner passes first-stage controls only
guides.tested: Ran the separately frozen full-family first-stage controls after the earlier execution failure, keeping the complete candidate family and correction.
guides.found: The authored positive, exact controls, and sampler checks passed their first-stage requirements. These were engineering/control results, not measured manuscript effects.
guides.unresolved: Actual-layout power and the remaining robustness gates were still required and had not run. Manuscript scoring remained closed.

guides.title: A consolidated account of the v3 study sequence
guides.tested: Collected existing v3.1/v3.2 reports, the completed qualification follow-up, the heterogeneity diagnosis, and later retrospective interpretation into one handoff.
guides.found: The larger fixed controls qualified the specified A/Q1 cells while preserving their earlier failures. The separate B-Q2 problem and the limits on family-level descriptive counts remained visible.
guides.unresolved: Consolidation did not run a new calculation or create fresh manuscript evidence. Read the separately owned replacement, re-adjudication, and descriptive reports for their distinct scopes.

guides.title: Checking that the consolidated delivery preserved its evidence
guides.tested: Performed a documentary and hash audit of the amendment and delivered v3.1/v3.2 artifacts.
guides.found: The retained check records the correspondence between the delivery files and their owning evidence. It is an audit receipt rather than a new statistical experiment.
guides.unresolved: Matching delivery hashes does not independently validate the scientific assumptions or promote a blocked result. No statistical runner was executed by this audit.

guides.title: Comparing association size across contexts
guides.tested: Displayed descriptive odds ratios and risk differences for the existing sh/ch-to-qok event population, with available-only comparisons primary.
guides.found: Effect estimates varied across contexts, and several intervals could not be estimated reliably. The map keeps unsupported intervals and the two readings separate.
guides.unresolved: An odds ratio is not a difference in percentage points. The map supplies no new significance test, global search correction, causal explanation, or meaning.

guides.title: Does allowing a different association in each context predict better?
guides.tested: Compared a common association model with context-varying deviations learned only on training folds, keeping each physical source group together.
guides.found: The varying model predicted the held-out allocation worse in both main readings under the primary partition. Fixed sensitivities and conditional score intervals were retained.
guides.unresolved: This predicts allocation within fixed margins, not overall qok frequency. The intervals omit training-refit variability and are not an inferential model-selection verdict.

guides.title: Recording a missed timing requirement honestly
guides.tested: Audited what registration work occurred before the requested amendment freeze and checked the retained source-only geometry and hold records.
guides.found: The timing requirement had been missed. The resolution preserved the evidence and explicit later authorization with a disclosed exception, rather than backdating compliance.
guides.unresolved: Source-only registration receipts do not establish that the entire cohort was independently re-reviewed. No scientific image/text result was created by this timing audit.

guides.title: A laboratory for comparing text structure and small predictive models
guides.tested: Built source parsers, descriptive measures, constructed writing-system controls, and short-budget predictive models, then added later source, segmentation, and direction studies.
guides.found: The main Phase 0–5 pipeline completed its registered fits and engineering checks. Its models and structural comparisons provide reproducible instruments, with later extensions preserving both partial successes and failed qualification gates.
guides.unresolved: The models were not trained to convergence or to translate. The early README stops at Phase 5; later extension and result folders have their own scopes and corrections, including important source-adapter failures.

guides.title: Decomposing only some shorthand signs into strokes
guides.tested: Swept fixed partial-decomposition schemes while preserving reversibility and the original short-budget model instrument.
guides.found: None of the completed settings simultaneously matched all three frozen descriptive bands. A pre-metric endpoint bug was caught and preserved before the corrected runs.
guides.unresolved: The bands are descriptive, and model fits may still be learning at their budget limit. No matching setting, reading, or historical mechanism was established.

guides.title: Pushing the decomposition sweep to its terminal settings
guides.tested: Completed the registered terminal cases and assembled full ranked comparisons with earlier settings and comparator systems.
guides.found: None matched all three descriptive bands. Many matched the model-gain band while missing the other measures, showing why one appealing metric was insufficient.
guides.unresolved: Aliases and reused endpoints are not independent replications. The bands do not establish equivalence, language identity, or a decipherment.

guides.title: Do saved letter maps transfer to unused annotations?
guides.tested: Applied two existing maps without adding assignments to annotation locations outside the month-fit folios, keeping competing readings and unknown letters explicit.
guides.found: Neither map recovered a complete multi-letter word in the admitted readings. The immediate finding was limited alphabet coverage.
guides.unresolved: The locations were unused in that fit rather than pristine blind data. Without independently established plaintext answers, translation accuracy was not estimable and the broader month relationship was not disproved.

guides.title: Code and registration for paragraph junction tests
guides.tested: Bound the paragraph specificity, reading-robustness, and annotated-subgroup comparisons before execution.
guides.found: The associated result records an aggregate specificity pass but failed reading robustness and mixed subgroup support. A later diagnostic then exposed an adapter/source-semantics limitation.
guides.unresolved: Use the separately stored K123 and K2D result reports together. Numerical reproduction does not certify paragraph interpretation, language, or spacing meaning.

guides.title: Checking what the paragraph adapter's markers mean
guides.tested: Registered semantic fixtures and source-fidelity checks before decomposing the reading-robustness failure.
guides.found: The associated K2D run stopped when both required semantic fixtures failed: layout locators had been treated as certified paragraph starts. Later diagnostic chains were not run.
guides.unresolved: This exposed a source-interpretation defect rather than repairing the earlier result. A separately registered correction was needed.

guides.title: Preparing a reviewed crosswalk to the original source
guides.tested: Retained source pairing, review decisions, span rules, and a separately bound execution plan for a source-grounded robustness follow-up.
guides.found: The archive includes preparations and execution bindings, alongside an earlier awaiting-review result checkpoint. A protocol or approved crosswalk is not evidence that all downstream tests completed.
guides.unresolved: Use an owning execution receipt to establish completion. This snapshot does not supply a later completed robustness or spacing conclusion.

guides.title: Correcting paragraph handling before source comparison
guides.tested: Separated layout markers from paragraph-start evidence and registered source collation before any boundary diagnostic.
guides.found: The associated run passed fifteen adapter fixtures, then failed source fidelity because differences and unresolved identities remained. The boundary diagnostic was not run.
guides.unresolved: A conversion mismatch is not automatically proof that either editorial representation is wrong. The earlier failures were not overwritten or rescued.

guides.title: Preparing the junction-feature calibration chains
guides.tested: Bound constructed mechanisms, literal unit definitions, conditional comparisons, and stopping rules before the JX calibration.
guides.found: The associated Phase 0 result passed several engineering/specificity chains but failed the spacing-reference ordering chain. Unrelated passes did not repair that failure.
guides.unresolved: Reference differences do not constitute a plaintext-space classifier or a language ranking. The unvalidated mapping PDF remained separate.

guides.title: Reviewing the junction proposal and candidate-language register
guides.tested: Checked source-backed premises, operational predictions, and the distinction between an experimental proposal and an asserted mapping.
guides.found: The review preserved source gaps and corrected drafts rather than treating the proposed Latin mapping as accepted evidence. It separated unit associations from phonological and causal claims.
guides.unresolved: This was a bounded documentary review, not a complete historical attestation project or an experimental calibration. A candidate list is not evidence that a candidate is the language.

guides.title: Are there enough secure picture pairs to test native text?
guides.tested: Collated localized proposed correspondences under predeclared confidence and unresolved-alternative rules before any target scoring.
guides.found: Only nine pairs were admitted as confident, short of the required fifteen. Tentative and contested proposals were not promoted to fill the gap, so calibration and target extraction did not run.
guides.unresolved: This is a source-support stop, not proof that no further pairs exist in the literature. A picture-pair proposal also does not establish native name-word locations.

guides.title: Can a unit-finding pipeline recover known plaintext structure?
guides.tested: Tested alternative segmentation/merge pipelines on natural text, planted encodings, and negative controls before manuscript use.
guides.found: Positive calibration failed, including under the requested identical-pipeline rule. An extra literal-letter anchor also introduced an acknowledged impossible combined gate, preserved as a design error rather than hidden.
guides.unresolved: The audit did not repair the failed merge method or identify manuscript units. No target segmentation, letter values, or meaning was scored.

guides.title: Would evaluating a continuous stream repair the unit test?
guides.tested: Re-evaluated the saved models under a declared continuous-stream amendment without refitting or altering the original failed results.
guides.found: Calibration still failed. The saved positives showed a merge-stage collapse from many chunks to very few units; removing dependence on spaces alone did not fix that problem.
guides.unresolved: This reused the same control banks and was not independent confirmation. Manuscript and conditional secondary scoring remained closed.

guides.title: An incomplete attempt to merge homophonic units
guides.tested: Prepared a larger hidden-state model search with multiple candidate unit counts and restart fits, separating positive recovery from specificity.
guides.found: Only a small fraction of the required branches completed. The full-length primary was incomplete, so specificity could not be interpreted as successful qualification.
guides.unresolved: Restart fits, branches, and independent sources are different counts. No letter values, language identity, or translation followed, and manuscript scoring stayed closed.

guides.title: Reading out a failed convention-count calibration
guides.tested: Re-examined the saved selected-group controls and provided a requested retrospective structured-control diagnosis.
guides.found: The operating criteria still failed, including excess rejections on independent-leaf controls. The report retained the failed calibration instead of turning a favorable pooled summary into a pass.
guides.unresolved: No new fixed-count hypothesis test was registered. The diagnostic did not authorize a manuscript physical-structure conclusion.

guides.title: Can the method recover the number of writing conventions?
guides.tested: Tested known one-, two-, and four-convention arrangements, including physical leaf and quire relationships, on constructed source material.
guides.found: None of the twenty-eight required cells passed the registered operating criteria. Selected group counts and physical tests did not reliably recover the known construction.
guides.unresolved: The failure limits this instrument. It does not establish how many conventions the manuscript uses or identify a historical reading order.

guides.title: Can two fitted cipher tables reproduce the A/B contrast?
guides.tested: Selected table settings using training data, then compared fixed two-table and one-table arms on separate evaluation material.
guides.found: The selector chose the same setting for both A and B, making the selected two-table arms exact aliases of their one-table controls. The resulting probes did not reproduce the manuscript's A/B separation.
guides.unresolved: This bounded selector did not instantiate distinct chosen tables. It does not reject unrestricted pairs of codebooks, and the published tables were developed with Voynich statistics rather than being blind controls.

guides.title: Can structural alignment distinguish shared from different plaintext?
guides.tested: Used genuinely different fixed substitution tables and tested graph alignment on same-source and different-source known controls.
guides.found: Required qualification failed. Many different-source/two-key datasets were incorrectly classified as shared-source/two-key cases, despite significant mapping gains.
guides.unresolved: Mapping gain under this comparison did not establish shared plaintext. No manuscript graph alignment or learned mapping was computed.

guides.title: Checking whether proposed cribs have adequate sources
guides.tested: Inventoried historical plant proposals, month annotations, period name forms, and four-language evidence coverage before registering scoring.
guides.found: The source-stage audit exposed missing prerequisites. The collected rows were proposals and evidence records, not a set of qualified plant-name pairs or a completed label/illustration experiment.
guides.unresolved: Modern translations and scientific species names could not stand in for period spellings. Native target scoring and calibration remained closed at this checkpoint.

guides.title: Qualifying a matcher for the later month annotations
guides.tested: Tested mapping recovery and the complete language/family search on planted month-label datasets and shuffled negatives.
guides.found: All thirty-two calibration cells passed. A separate strict receipt check failed because a mutable progress file had mistakenly been included in the frozen manifest; that defect was disclosed while immutable inputs remained unchanged.
guides.unresolved: No annotation target fit ran in this calibration folder. The later Latin-script annotations are a separate track from the native Voynich text, and the finite controls do not identify its language.

guides.title: Preparing a more careful historical month-name comparison
guides.tested: Registered finite spelling-variant rules, distinct-month counting, language comparisons, and a bounded source census before new fitting.
guides.found: The retained deliverable is an incomplete source census and registered design. Calibration and annotation fitting had not run.
guides.unresolved: Generated spelling alternatives must remain distinguishable from attested forms. This is not a negative language-identification result or a completed variant freeze.

guides.title: Extending the model lab with published approaches and controls
guides.tested: Collected pinned prior implementations, extended baselines, mixed-membership methods, dictionary comparisons, and additional neural work.
guides.found: The retained status records completed baselines and partial control qualification, including failed word/phrase recovery, while other work and final verification were still pending. Human coherence ratings remained blank.
guides.unresolved: The status of one finished component does not establish completion of the full batch. No qualified latent-language or translation conclusion is supplied by the incomplete recovery work.

guides.title: Code for a circular-only boundary follow-up
guides.tested: Bound a follow-up focused on longer circular calibration examples after the first direction study stopped.
guides.found: Its associated result could locate some retained boundaries but lacked supported unique-origin cases. The separate follow-up stopped at that required gate.
guides.unresolved: A likely boundary is not necessarily the original start of a ring. Radial work and real-ring scoring were not opened.

guides.title: Code for direction fingerprints and directed-origin calibration
guides.tested: Registered additional generator controls and an origin test that included uncertainty in the inferred direction.
guides.found: The associated follow-up retained generator direction failures and a narrow manuscript-paragraph origin pass, with failures in the longer and Latin origin panels.
guides.unresolved: One realized generator does not represent every member of its class. Paragraph calibration does not establish transfer to actual circular text.

guides.title: Design and initial calibration for ring direction
guides.tested: Reviewed whether proposed direction and start statistics could identify what they claimed, then bound an amended calibration.
guides.found: The preflight exposed rotation-invariant and non-unique-origin problems. The subsequent first calibration passed some circular direction gates but failed radial direction, triggering its stop rule.
guides.unresolved: The source inventory is not a set of adjudicated independent rings. No corrected manuscript order or real-ring score followed.

guides.title: A richer ring-direction calibration design
guides.tested: Separated word and cross-boundary unit direction, generator fingerprints, origin, pooled tests, uncertainty views, and missing-source arms.
guides.found: The associated run found strong unit-direction recovery in several paragraph bins, while word direction, pooled tests, origin alternatives, and some controls failed or lacked support.
guides.unresolved: The chains have separate gates; one pass does not clear unrelated failures. The recorded outcomes remain calibration rather than actual ring interpretation.

guides.title: Junction-feature calibration results
guides.tested: Executed the separately bound engineering, specificity, conditioning, spacing, and empirical-reference chains.
guides.found: Engineering and several control chains passed, but spacing-reference ordering failed. The reference profiles were descriptive only.
guides.unresolved: Unit associations and reference-profile distances do not identify phonology, plaintext spaces, a language, or an accepted mapping. No interpretation-stage manuscript test ran.

guides.title: Paragraph specificity and reading-robustness results
guides.tested: Compared the junction measure with fixed alternatives, tested alternate-reading robustness, and retained predeclared subgroup breakdowns.
guides.found: Aggregate specificity passed, but aggregate reading robustness failed. Subgroups had mixed passes, failures, and insufficient support; a later adapter diagnostic qualified how the reading comparison could be interpreted.
guides.unresolved: The source families had earlier exposure. Read the subsequent K2D and corrected-source reports before treating numerical repeatability as source or paragraph validity.

guides.title: The adapter-semantic diagnostic stop
guides.tested: Tested the original adapter's meaning of layout locators before downstream source and reading decompositions.
guides.found: Both mandatory semantic fixtures failed because layout markers were treated as paragraph-start evidence. The run stopped and downstream diagnostics remained unrun.
guides.unresolved: The earlier numerical results were preserved, but their reproducibility did not certify source semantics. No repair was substituted into this failed run.

guides.title: A corrected adapter followed by a source-fidelity failure
guides.tested: Checked the corrected adapter, then collated the selected reading against the hash-bound original archive before any boundary diagnosis.
guides.found: All fifteen adapter fixtures passed. Source fidelity failed: among 3,810 selected locations, matches coexisted with held spans, unresolved identities, and conversion differences; the downstream diagnostic did not run.
guides.unresolved: Unresolved conversion differences do not automatically identify which representation is wrong. No new direction fit, spacing interpretation, or real-ring score followed.

guides.title: The archived K2R source-review checkpoint
guides.tested: Stored the source crosswalk, parser fixtures, held metadata, and review binding for a proposed original-source robustness follow-up.
guides.found: The retained result checkpoint awaits crosswalk review, while newer execution preparations are separately archived under the extension. No completed downstream result is implied by those preparations.
guides.unresolved: Use dated execution receipts rather than the older status alone. This snapshot does not contain a completed K2R robustness or boundary conclusion.

guides.title: Can a calibrated circular boundary be made unique?
guides.tested: Tested unit mirroring, location of any retained boundary, and unique source origin in longer circular calibration examples.
guides.found: Mirroring and any-boundary recovery passed, but unique-origin support was absent. The run stopped before the remaining pairing-null stage.
guides.unresolved: Finding some boundary does not identify a unique ring start. This did not repair the original radial failure or open real-ring scoring.

guides.title: Additional direction controls and paragraph-origin tests
guides.tested: Added the pinned published generator and a fixed table/grille control, then tested origin recovery using the inferred direction.
guides.found: Both added generator direction chains failed their gates. One ZL paragraph-origin bin passed at the performance threshold, while the longer ZL bin and Latin origin panels failed.
guides.unresolved: The results constrain the tested realizations and panels, not entire mechanism classes. Paragraph-to-ring transfer remained untested.

guides.title: The first circular and radial direction calibration
guides.tested: Tested direction recovery across length bins on paragraph-derived circular and radial examples and known-text controls.
guides.found: Longer circular examples could pass, but radial direction did not qualify. The original gate sequence therefore stopped.
guides.unresolved: A failed short-text calibration is not a discovered direction for the manuscript's radial labels. No actual ring interpretation was produced.

guides.title: Checking ring-direction identifiability before calibration
guides.tested: Inventoried circular/radial source locations and tested authored counterexamples to the proposed direction and start rules.
guides.found: A maximum over rotations could not identify its own rotation, and equally strong boundaries need not identify one unique start. The initial proposal stopped for design review.
guides.unresolved: The inventory counts source locations, not independently confirmed complete rings. No empirical calibration or corrected order existed at this stage.

guides.title: Separate direction, origin, and pooled-test chains
guides.tested: Ran the richer calibrated suite on paragraph-derived examples, controls, and source-sensitive views.
guides.found: Cross-boundary unit direction passed several ZL bins, but whole-word direction did not qualify there. Other chains had mixed failures, insufficient support, or missing-source stops.
guides.unresolved: The signals are instrument- and representation-specific. A passing direction chain does not identify a ring start, seam count, plaintext space, or historical mechanism.

guides.title: Keeping research decisions, reserves, and statistical spending traceable
guides.tested: Built a staged ledger and role/custody system intended to separate exploratory proposals, frozen tests, qualification, protected scoring, and review.
guides.found: The retained checkpoint includes hash-chained records, projection checks, runner tests, and staged isolation work. Its README records that autonomous research and live model inference were not activated at that checkpoint.
guides.unresolved: Passing software tests is not full operating-system custody or methodological qualification. Publishing this folder does not activate the loop, authorize reserve access, or make a claim test valid.

guides.title: Locating text inside, on, and outside diagrams
guides.tested: Mapped source-described diagram units to spatial categories and inspected their word-part profiles, retaining ambiguities and missing rings.
guides.found: The inventory made the spatial labels explicit, but comparable same-format contrasts were too sparse for the desired spatial interpretation. One reading lacked ring coverage, and parts of the Rosettes inventory were missing.
guides.unresolved: This was not fresh blinded image registration. Labels and ring text cannot simply be pooled as if format and location were interchangeable.

guides.title: Do section contrasts survive a wider word-part search?
guides.tested: Expanded the controlled inventory to all observed contiguous word parts and checked selected signals across retrospective folio splits and removal of frequent training words.
guides.found: Twenty-one overlapping contrasts passed the expanded screen, and four focal families retained their direction across the recorded splits. Some earlier candidates lost significance when the search family widened.
guides.unresolved: The splits reused exposed material. Operational spelling families do not establish linguistic roots, syllables, or meanings.

guides.title: Can the scorer recover the historical degree-table pattern in controls?
guides.tested: Ran a separate constructed-data qualification for the male/female degree table using the unchanged full-search scorer.
guides.found: All seven frozen gates passed, including noisy and partly missing planted signals and several nuisance controls. This strengthened coverage of that table within the authored simulation scope.
guides.unresolved: It did not score any manuscript alignment or held-out sign, establish a historical identification, or guarantee sensitivity to the actual ambiguous images.

guides.title: Testing the corrected clothing observations against degree tables
guides.tested: Applied the unchanged qualified scorer to the already corrected clothing observations and fixed development geometry.
guides.found: Clothing now had usable variation, but its alignment did not pass. Enclosure remained constant within groups and therefore not estimable. No qualifying rule was carried forward.
guides.unresolved: The negative result concerns the specified development test. It does not identify clothing with the table's sex categories, and the reserved zodiac signs remained unscored.

guides.title: Why the first real degree-table application could not be estimated
guides.tested: Applied the frozen alignment scorer to the first-pass clothing and enclosure inventory while controlling for group frequencies.
guides.found: Both stored features were constant within groups, leaving no variation to align. The numerical zero scores and p-values of one were degenerate outputs, not informative negative tests or winning rules.
guides.unresolved: A later image audit showed that the clothing uniformity was partly an annotation artifact. This folder preserves the original application rather than rewriting it with corrected observations.

guides.title: Preparing a zodiac image-feature inventory
guides.tested: Froze a development/confirmation split and began locating figures and possible visual features without reading their glyph labels.
guides.found: The initial inventory was incomplete and exposed geometry problems: an observed count of 29, extra groups, and uncertain features could not be forced into an ideal thirty-degree template.
guides.unresolved: No degree comparison or completed feature map was produced here. A preparation failure is not a negative test of the historical table hypothesis.

guides.title: Checking whether uniform clothing labels matched the images
guides.tested: Reinspected the exposed development images without consulting alignment fits, preserving the original labels and all corrections.
guides.found: Five eligible groups contained both clothed and bare figures after correction. The earlier zero-variation calculation was correct for its stored labels but could not stand as a claim that the drawings themselves lacked variation.
guides.unresolved: This was a same-agent reinspection, not independent blinded annotation. It supplied corrected observations, not a new alignment result or winning rule.

guides.title: Mapping zodiac figures before comparing tables
guides.tested: Recorded approximate figure and adjacent-label locations, clothing and enclosure judgments, and unresolved features before inspecting the historical degree-table pages.
guides.found: The first-pass inventory preserved uncertain figure counts, unknown pigment, approximate label ownership, and irregular group geometry. The historical table pages were then sourced without performing an alignment fit.
guides.unresolved: Approximate locators are not precise segmentation or confirmed label ownership. Several held-out images remained unannotated, and fine visual features were not established.

guides.title: Transcribing historical tables and qualifying the search
guides.tested: Transcribed the two printed degree-table schemes and tested the complete traversal/template search on planted signals and nuisance controls.
guides.found: The numeric rows and operative legend were checked, and the frozen synthetic suite passed. The search correction included all admitted templates and offsets rather than only a favorable match.
guides.unresolved: Two readings of one scan are not independent textual witnesses. This did not test the manuscript or establish that the depicted figures encode the historical categories; later work addressed actual image support.
